  "headline": "Conversion Rate fell -7.2% (‑0.0057) in the period 2 Mar – 12 Apr 2026.",
  "sentences": [
    { "text": "The analysis uses a difference‑in‑differences (DiD) framework comparing the focal period (2 Mar – 12 Apr 2026) to the prior period (19 Jan – 1 Mar 2026) at a daily grain.", "tier_from": "answer" },
    { "text": "The primary treated segment is the North‑Web‑Personal Care category, which contributed an absolute decline of –0.0075 to the conversion‑rate metric and accounts for the largest share of movement.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "A DiD test on this segment shows a treated change of –9.5 % versus a control change of 0.0 % (z = ‑4.8), which survived the falsification check, indicating a statistically significant drop.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "Placebo‑timing validation yielded a diff‑in‑diff of +3.3 pp against a noise standard of 2.0 pp (1 window), also surviving, supporting the robustness of the primary signal.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "The control segment exhibited no movement (0.0 %), confirming that the observed decline is not driven by broader platform trends.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "A rival‑category test (Personal Care overall) shows the treated segment moved –9.5 % while the broader category moved –2.2 %, with a DiD of –7.3 % that survived, suggesting the effect is not solely a category‑wide phenomenon.", "tier_from": "drivers[1]" },
    { "text": "Placebo and control checks for the rival‑category driver also survived, but the dose‑response test remained inconclusive, limiting confidence in a monotonic relationship over time.", "tier_from": "drivers[1]" },
    { "text": "Two falsification hypotheses were rejected: broader region = North and broader channel = Web, each showing only –2.6 % treated movement versus 0 % control (z = ‑1.3), indicating they do not explain the primary drop.", "tier_from": "rejected_hypotheses[0]" },
    { "text": "The recommended action is to investigate the North‑Web‑Personal Care checkout flow (lever: checkout_incident_response) with Growth owning the effort; the expected recovered gap is 0.0057 in conversion rate, to be monitored for 14 days aiming for within 2 % of baseline.", "tier_from": "answer.action" }
  ]
